title: A 321-Layer 2Tb 4b/cell 3D-NAND-Flash Memory with a 75MB/s Program Throughput
problem: High-density NAND Flash memory must simultaneously improve sequential and random-access performance, reliability, and read/write efficiency to support enterprise SSD and AI workloads demanding fast data transfers.
motivation: Explosive growth in enterprise SSDs and AI systems requires unprecedented memory density and speed while maintaining QLC (4-bit/cell) density.
method: Employs 321-layer 3D NAND-Flash architecture achieving 2Tb capacity with 4 bits per cell storage density and 75MB/s program throughput through optimized multi-layer stacking and cell programming schemes.
key_novelty: Integration of ultra-high layer count (321 layers) with high-density 4-bit/cell encoding while maintaining practical program throughput.
contributions: 2Tb total capacity using 321-layer 3D-NAND stack with 4b/cell density
75MB/s program throughput enabling fast write performance
Improved reliability metrics for QLC NAND in enterprise SSD deployments
primary_theme: High-density 3D NAND flash for enterprise storage.
